name: ambit-unified
description: Unified Ambit workspace with React + Vite frontend and Next.js backend

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true}); ['backend/public/server.cjs', 'backend/public/server.cjs.map'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.unlinkSync(f); });"
scripts.build:backend: npx --prefix backend prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('backend/.next')) fs.cpSync('backend/.next', '.next', {recursive:true});"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
